<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The formula that best matches this mass is C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.1045 Da), which is within typical experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
